The true meaning of patriotism
hist.x: Every year on August 15 and January 26, the country follows the same ritual: Flags are hoisted, anthems… Every year on August 15 and January 26, the country follows the same ritual: Flags are hoisted, anthems are sung and cultural programmes are organised. By evening, we return to business as usual. For one day, patriotism is performed. For the rest of the year, it is forgotten. This is the problem with reducing love for one’s country to a calendar event: It turns a living idea into a mere formality, something to observe rather than something to practise.
